title: RICHARDSON ELECTRONICS REPORTS STRONG FIRST QUARTER RESULTS; DECLARES QUARTERLY CASH DIVIDEND

body_markdown:
*First quarter net sales increased 18.9% year over year, with growth across all three business units*


*First quarter net income increased 112.6% to $4.1 million, or $0.27 per common share (diluted)*


*Company generated free cash flow of $4.2 million for first quarter*


*Backlog at August 29, 2026 was $184.4 million, up 36.9% year-over-year*
